data: Baci se na pod (Kick and Scream)

Posljednji trenuci zafrkancije, nježnosti i apsurda prije rastanka jedne obitelji. Dok se roditelji bave zamjeranjima i prebacivanjem krivnje, njihov šestogodišnji sin svoj svijet gradi kroz igru. Svatko ima svoju istinu, u čiju ćete povjerovati? (The racehorse Cagliostro, who Lou often takes care of, is poisoned on the neighbouring farm. If the horse is to have a chance of surviving, it must be hidden from the perpetrator who is still running free.)

The racehorse Cagliostro, who Lou often takes care of, is poisoned on the neighbouring farm. If the horse is to have a chance of surviving, it must be hidden from the perpetrator who is still running free.
